lead: From a page worth sharing to the last check-in. Publish your event, review applications and welcome your community with Event Flow.
step1Detail: Your page. Your form. Your schedule.
step3Detail: An individual QR ticket on approval.
step4Detail: Check-in, badges and your event team.
flowFooter: Less switching between tools. More room for people.
stagesTitle:
A clear next step.

At every stage.
stagesIntro: Your event changes as the day gets closer. Keep the planning, admission and arrival work connected from the start.
prepareText: Start in a draft. Add the details, build your form and preview the experience. Publish when everything is ready.
prepare1: A cover and schedule that tell your story
prepare2: Public discovery or a private direct link
prepare3: Changes go live only when you publish
comingText: Collect the answers you need, review applications and approve people as places become available.
coming3: Tickets and email updates after approval
doorText: Give your team a shared workspace for arrivals. Scan a ticket, find an attendee or print a badge.
toolsIntro: Build the event you have in mind, then keep the practical work in the same place.
pageTitle: A page that feels like your event
pageText: Bring your event to life with a cropped cover, formatted description, schedule, venue or online location, and organizer details.
formText: Build your registration form with text, choice and checkbox fields. Set required answers, capacity and an application window.
teamTitle: The right access for your team
teamText: Bring in Managers to help review applications and Reception staff to welcome attendees. Each role gets the tools it needs.
commText: Application updates go out by email. Send a message to attendees, pending applicants or your event team, and review delivery status.
welcomeText: Create printable badges, scan QR tickets or check people in manually. See who has arrived in your event workspace.
repeatText: Duplicate an event or reuse its configuration with templates. Export application and attendee data when you need to work with it elsewhere.
invitation: ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE INVITATION
attendeeLead: Discover your next event, apply to attend and get the details you need for the day.
findPeopleText: Browse public events, explore the schedule and see what’s planned.
aboutYouText: Complete the application and receive its status updates by email.
ticketText: Once approved, access your QR ticket and get ready to check in.
faqIntro: A clear picture of how Event Flow works.
reviewQuestion: Can I review applications before admitting people?
reviewAnswer: Yes. Submissions arrive as pending applications. An organizer or authorized Manager reviews them, and approval grants admission and creates a ticket. A submitted application alone does not reserve a place.
accountQuestion: Do attendees need an Event Flow account?
accountAnswer: You choose. Events can accept applications without an account or require a verified account. Approved anonymous applicants receive a private ticket link by email.
privateQuestion: Can I keep an event out of the public catalog?
privateAnswer: Yes. Publish it as Private to exclude it from discovery. People with its direct link can still view it; Private is not password protection.
editQuestion: What happens when I edit a published event?
editAnswer: Your edits stay in the organizer workspace until you publish the changes. You can preview the updated event and registration form before making them public.
teamQuestion: Can my team help at the event?
teamAnswer: Yes. Assign Manager or Reception access to verified users. Managers can review applications and handle check-in; Reception staff get access to the arrival workflow.
closingLead: Start with an idea. Turn it into a place to meet.
closingExplore: Just here to explore? Find an event.
